aws.title: New EC2 instance family announced for ML inference
aws.summary: AWS announces a new instance type with better price performance for general workloads and inference use cases.

kubernetes.title: Kubernetes v1.31.2 patch release available
kubernetes.summary: This patch release addresses several bug fixes reported since the v1.31.1 release, including a kubelet memory leak.

terraform.title: Terraform 1.9.4 released with provider fixes
terraform.summary: This release resolves an issue with state locking under high concurrency.

go.title: Go 1.23 released
go.summary: Go 1.23 brings iterator support and performance improvements to the toolchain.

javascript.title: Node.js 22 is now Active LTS
javascript.summary: Node.js 22 moves into Active LTS with a built-in WebSocket client and V8 12.4 updates.
